1038369065-us.title: Ok, but could be better
1038369065-us.text:
I’ve been using this for about a year or so - I like how well it’s gotten at predicting my period and ovulation. The interface is simple and easy to use. I also really like the partner feature!! But a few problems I have with it: 
1. There are some things it gives insight on that you can only get if it suggests it to you with a chat. Sleep quality in particular is one. I would LOVE to get that update every day and see how I slept, but it really seems like I can only find out if it decides to suggest a “how did I sleep” chat. And you can’t ask about it with the “start a new chat” either since it only gives you the option to start with specific topics. Why have a chatbot feature if you can’t actually interact with it fully and it’s locked to specific topics?
2. I have endometriosis and I wanted to log it as a condition I have so I could track my symptoms better with that context, and so it would finally stop asking me to take an endometriosis assessment based on my logged symptoms. I had surgery and 100% definitively have it. I was only finally get it to able to log it by taking the assessment multiple times and hoping it would finally ask me “have you been formally diagnosed?”  There should be an option to configure or add conditions. 
3. And finally, for a while I was only medication to suppress my period due to my condition. There is not an option to cycle track for something like that (instead of just period as normal or perimenopause). I would like to be able to log my cycle according to my pill days and when I would’ve likely got my period based on that (along with my symptoms since hormonal medications can impact that). That is not a knock against this app like the others, because it would be an added feature, but I think this would really help a lot of people. 

Unfortunately, I’m just not quite getting enough use out of this app to justify continuing to pay for it. I’m sure it works great for a lot of people, but for my specific case it’s just not quite enough (which is ok, I recognize I am not the majority)

1038369065-it.title: COSA RIMANE DAVVERO SENZA PREMIUM?
1038369065-it.text:
Ho usato Flo per il monitoraggio del ciclo e ora che sono in gravidanza ho continuato a usarla. Peccato che ormai, ogni volta che provo a vedere un’informazione o approfondire qualcosa, mi venga chiesto di passare a Premium.

Capisco mettere alcune funzioni avanzate a pagamento, ma qui sembra che la versione gratuita serva solo a ricordarti che esiste quella Premium. 😅

Sia per il ciclo che per la gravidanza, le informazioni realmente utili sono praticamente tutte bloccate. Alla fine l’app offre pochissimo se non paghi un abbonamento.

Un vero peccato, perché l’app potrebbe essere molto utile, ma così l’esperienza è frustrante e sembra più interessata a venderti Premium che a fornire un servizio.

429135422-us.title: New design is flawed (Dec 2024)
429135422-us.text:
I like this app and have been using it for years.
I’m not a fan of the new design, as options navigation are not that intuitive (it’s not a matter of a learning curve, it’s just not intuitive). The biggest flaw so far in the new design is in the Summary. The Cycles chart new design make it completely useless. There’s no way of looking at it to visualize the length of the cycle. One needs to read the number written next to each cycle one by one. It completely defies the purpose of the chart. I understand the value of adding the heat data in there, but the way it was implemented in the design made it useless and unusable.

429135422-us.title: Hasn’t aged as well as I hoped
429135422-us.text:
I have been using this app for over a decade. I have paid for account upgrades over the years, but they keep adding new ‘levels’, taking away the ‘unlocked’ features that were promised years back when I paid for it. On top of that, there is no way to update the email address that’s used on the account. This is horrible. My account is linked to an email address that would otherwise be deleted, as it is associated with people/things in my past that were unsafe to me. When I asked for help with this, the person from WomanLog who answered said they can’t help me. If you’re going to charge people, at least have the decency to take your customer’s safety and security seriously. I NEED to change the email address associated with this account.
Next thing- there is period tracking, pregnancy mode, and menopause mode. There is, however, NO perimenopause mode. We are learning more and more how important it is to start managing things in perimenopause, and how that can have a very positive effect on full menopause. A perimenopause mode seems vital to early management.

I hope these things can be resolved. Aside from that, I have found the app to be efficient. I would not have continued to use it for over a decade if it wasn’t. I did try a couple other apps, and found they just didn’t tick the boxes for me.

429135422-us.title: Outdated, was good but now behind other apps
429135422-us.text:
I’ve been using WomanLog Pro for a few years now. I was pleased to have a place to log my cycle and symptoms. It’s glitch free. 

I recently tested Flo and like how it uses the my information to give me specific feedback about my cycle. 

WomanLog is just that a place to log, but does not give you much else. I have the paid version, but since I got it, they made upgrades to the app with the intelligent assistant which is not included on my plan, they require a monthly subscription. 

It basically seems that if you purchased the pro version a while ago, it just stagnated. You can log more symptoms, but it does not give you more back. 

I think it’s a general mistake of developers to upgrade the version and not keep their original customers up to date. I could be telling my friends how good this app has gotten, instead I will say not worth it, get a different one.
